SELECT w.oid,
    w.fdwowner,
    w.fdwoptions,
    (current_database())::name AS foreign_data_wrapper_catalog,
    (w.fdwname)::name AS foreign_data_wrapper_name,
    (u.rolname)::name AS authorization_identifier,
    ('c'::character varying)::character varying AS foreign_data_wrapper_language
   FROM pg_foreign_data_wrapper w,
    pg_authid u
  WHERE ((u.oid = w.fdwowner) AND (pg_has_role(w.fdwowner, 'USAGE'::text) OR has_foreign_data_wrapper_privilege(w.oid, 'USAGE'::text)));

SELECT s.oid,
    s.srvoptions,
    (current_database())::name AS foreign_server_catalog,
    (s.srvname)::name AS foreign_server_name,
    (current_database())::name AS foreign_data_wrapper_catalog,
    (w.fdwname)::name AS foreign_data_wrapper_name,
    (s.srvtype)::character varying AS foreign_server_type,
    (s.srvversion)::character varying AS foreign_server_version,
    (u.rolname)::name AS authorization_identifier
   FROM pg_foreign_server s,
    pg_foreign_data_wrapper w,
    pg_authid u
  WHERE ((w.oid = s.srvfdw) AND (u.oid = s.srvowner) AND (pg_has_role(s.srvowner, 'USAGE'::text) OR has_server_privilege(s.oid, 'USAGE'::text)));

SELECT n.nspname,
    c.relname,
    a.attname,
    a.attfdwoptions
   FROM pg_foreign_table t,
    pg_authid u,
    pg_namespace n,
    pg_class c,
    pg_attribute a
  WHERE ((u.oid = c.relowner) AND (pg_has_role(c.relowner, 'USAGE'::text) OR has_column_privilege(c.oid, a.attnum, 'SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, REFERENCES'::text)) AND (n.oid = c.relnamespace) AND (c.oid = t.ftrelid) AND (c.relkind = 'f'::"char") AND (a.attrelid = c.oid) AND (a.attnum > 0));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS foreign_table_catalog,
    (n.nspname)::name AS foreign_table_schema,
    (c.relname)::name AS foreign_table_name,
    t.ftoptions,
    (current_database())::name AS foreign_server_catalog,
    (s.srvname)::name AS foreign_server_name,
    (u.rolname)::name AS authorization_identifier
   FROM pg_foreign_table t,
    pg_foreign_server s,
    pg_foreign_data_wrapper w,
    pg_authid u,
    pg_namespace n,
    pg_class c
  WHERE ((w.oid = s.srvfdw) AND (u.oid = c.relowner) AND (pg_has_role(c.relowner, 'USAGE'::text) OR has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER'::text) OR has_any_column_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, REFERENCES'::text)) AND (n.oid = c.relnamespace) AND (c.oid = t.ftrelid) AND (c.relkind = 'f'::"char") AND (s.oid = t.ftserver));

SELECT um.oid,
    um.umoptions,
    um.umuser,
    (COALESCE(u.rolname, 'PUBLIC'::name))::name AS authorization_identifier,
    s.foreign_server_catalog,
    s.foreign_server_name,
    s.authorization_identifier AS srvowner
   FROM (pg_user_mapping um
     LEFT JOIN pg_authid u ON ((u.oid = um.umuser))),
    information_schema._pg_foreign_servers s
  WHERE (s.oid = um.umserver);

SELECT (current_database())::name AS udt_catalog,
    (nc.nspname)::name AS udt_schema,
    (c.relname)::name AS udt_name,
    (a.attname)::name AS attribute_name,
    (a.attnum)::integer AS ordinal_position,
    (pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid))::character varying AS attribute_default,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (a.attnotnull OR ((t.typtype = 'd'::"char") AND t.typnotnull)) THEN 'NO'::text
            ELSE 'YES'::text
        END)::character varying(3) AS is_nullable,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.typelem <> (0)::oid) AND (t.typlen = '-1'::integer)) THEN 'ARRAY'::text
            WHEN (nt.nspname = 'pg_catalog'::name) THEN format_type(a.atttypid, NULL::integer)
            ELSE 'USER-DEFINED'::text
        END)::character varying AS data_type,
    (information_schema._pg_char_max_length(CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE a.atttypid END, CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typtypmod ELSE a.atttypmod END))::integer AS character_maximum_length,
    (information_schema._pg_char_octet_length(CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE a.atttypid END, CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typtypmod ELSE a.atttypmod END))::integer AS character_octet_length,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_catalog,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_schema,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_name,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (nco.nspname IS NOT NULL) THEN current_database()
            ELSE NULL::name
        END)::name AS collation_catalog,
    (nco.nspname)::name AS collation_schema,
    (co.collname)::name AS collation_name,
    (information_schema._pg_numeric_precision(CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE a.atttypid END, CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typtypmod ELSE a.atttypmod END))::integer AS numeric_precision,
    (information_schema._pg_numeric_precision_radix(CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE a.atttypid END, CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typtypmod ELSE a.atttypmod END))::integer AS numeric_precision_radix,
    (information_schema._pg_numeric_scale(CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE a.atttypid END, CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typtypmod ELSE a.atttypmod END))::integer AS numeric_scale,
    (information_schema._pg_datetime_precision(CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE a.atttypid END, CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typtypmod ELSE a.atttypmod END))::integer AS datetime_precision,
    (information_schema._pg_interval_type(CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE a.atttypid END, CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typtypmod ELSE a.atttypmod END))::character varying AS interval_type,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS interval_precision,
    (current_database())::name AS attribute_udt_catalog,
    (nt.nspname)::name AS attribute_udt_schema,
    (t.typname)::name AS attribute_udt_name,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_catalog,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_schema,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_name,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS maximum_cardinality,
    (a.attnum)::name AS dtd_identifier,
    ('NO'::character varying)::character varying(3) AS is_derived_reference_attribute
   FROM ((((pg_attribute a
     LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON (((a.attrelid = ad.adrelid) AND (a.attnum = ad.adnum))))
     JOIN (pg_class c
     JOIN pg_namespace nc ON ((c.relnamespace = nc.oid))) ON ((a.attrelid = c.oid)))
     JOIN (pg_type t
     JOIN pg_namespace nt ON ((t.typnamespace = nt.oid))) ON ((a.atttypid = t.oid)))
     LEFT JOIN (pg_collation co
     JOIN pg_namespace nco ON ((co.collnamespace = nco.oid))) ON (((a.attcollation = co.oid) AND ((nco.nspname <> 'pg_catalog'::name) OR (co.collname <> 'default'::name)))))
  WHERE ((a.attnum > 0) AND (NOT a.attisdropped) AND (c.relkind = 'c'::"char") AND (pg_has_role(c.relowner, 'USAGE'::text) OR has_type_privilege(c.reltype, 'USAGE'::text)));

SELECT DISTINCT (current_database())::name AS constraint_catalog,
    (nc.nspname)::name AS constraint_schema,
    (c.conname)::name AS constraint_name,
    (current_database())::name AS specific_catalog,
    (np.nspname)::name AS specific_schema,
    (nameconcatoid(p.proname, p.oid))::name AS specific_name
   FROM pg_namespace nc,
    pg_constraint c,
    pg_depend d,
    pg_proc p,
    pg_namespace np
  WHERE ((nc.oid = c.connamespace) AND (c.contype = 'c'::"char") AND (c.oid = d.objid) AND (d.classid = ('pg_constraint'::regclass)::oid) AND (d.refobjid = p.oid) AND (d.refclassid = ('pg_proc'::regclass)::oid) AND (p.pronamespace = np.oid) AND pg_has_role(p.proowner, 'USAGE'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS collation_catalog,
    (nc.nspname)::name AS collation_schema,
    (c.collname)::name AS collation_name,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_catalog,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_schema,
    (getdatabaseencoding())::name AS character_set_name
   FROM pg_collation c,
    pg_namespace nc
  WHERE ((c.collnamespace = nc.oid) AND (c.collencoding = ANY (ARRAY['-1'::integer, ( SELECT pg_database.encoding
           FROM pg_database
          WHERE (pg_database.datname = current_database()))])));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS collation_catalog,
    (nc.nspname)::name AS collation_schema,
    (c.collname)::name AS collation_name,
    ('NO PAD'::character varying)::character varying AS pad_attribute
   FROM pg_collation c,
    pg_namespace nc
  WHERE ((c.collnamespace = nc.oid) AND (c.collencoding = ANY (ARRAY['-1'::integer, ( SELECT pg_database.encoding
           FROM pg_database
          WHERE (pg_database.datname = current_database()))])));

SELECT DISTINCT (current_database())::name AS table_catalog,
    (n.nspname)::name AS table_schema,
    (c.relname)::name AS table_name,
    (ac.attname)::name AS column_name,
    (ad.attname)::name AS dependent_column
   FROM pg_namespace n,
    pg_class c,
    pg_depend d,
    pg_attribute ac,
    pg_attribute ad,
    pg_attrdef atd
  WHERE ((n.oid = c.relnamespace) AND (c.oid = ac.attrelid) AND (c.oid = ad.attrelid) AND (ac.attnum <> ad.attnum) AND (ad.attrelid = atd.adrelid) AND (ad.attnum = atd.adnum) AND (d.classid = ('pg_attrdef'::regclass)::oid) AND (d.refclassid = ('pg_class'::regclass)::oid) AND (d.objid = atd.oid) AND (d.refobjid = ac.attrelid) AND (d.refobjsubid = ac.attnum) AND (ad.attgenerated <> ''::"char") AND pg_has_role(c.relowner, 'USAGE'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS domain_catalog,
    (nt.nspname)::name AS domain_schema,
    (t.typname)::name AS domain_name,
    (current_database())::name AS table_catalog,
    (nc.nspname)::name AS table_schema,
    (c.relname)::name AS table_name,
    (a.attname)::name AS column_name
   FROM pg_type t,
    pg_namespace nt,
    pg_class c,
    pg_namespace nc,
    pg_attribute a
  WHERE ((t.typnamespace = nt.oid) AND (c.relnamespace = nc.oid) AND (a.attrelid = c.oid) AND (a.atttypid = t.oid) AND (t.typtype = 'd'::"char") AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND (a.attnum > 0) AND (NOT a.attisdropped) AND pg_has_role(t.typowner, 'USAGE'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS table_catalog,
    (nspname)::name AS table_schema,
    (relname)::name AS table_name,
    (attname)::name AS column_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(attfdwoptions)).option_name)::name AS option_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(attfdwoptions)).option_value)::character varying AS option_value
   FROM information_schema._pg_foreign_table_columns c;

SELECT (current_database())::name AS udt_catalog,
    (COALESCE(nbt.nspname, nt.nspname))::name AS udt_schema,
    (COALESCE(bt.typname, t.typname))::name AS udt_name,
    (current_database())::name AS table_catalog,
    (nc.nspname)::name AS table_schema,
    (c.relname)::name AS table_name,
    (a.attname)::name AS column_name
   FROM pg_attribute a,
    pg_class c,
    pg_namespace nc,
    ((pg_type t
     JOIN pg_namespace nt ON ((t.typnamespace = nt.oid)))
     LEFT JOIN (pg_type bt
     JOIN pg_namespace nbt ON ((bt.typnamespace = nbt.oid))) ON (((t.typtype = 'd'::"char") AND (t.typbasetype = bt.oid))))
  WHERE ((a.attrelid = c.oid) AND (a.atttypid = t.oid) AND (nc.oid = c.relnamespace) AND (a.attnum > 0) AND (NOT a.attisdropped) AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND pg_has_role(COALESCE(bt.typowner, t.typowner), 'USAGE'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS table_catalog,
    (nr.nspname)::name AS table_schema,
    (r.relname)::name AS table_name,
    (current_database())::name AS constraint_catalog,
    (nc.nspname)::name AS constraint_schema,
    (c.conname)::name AS constraint_name
   FROM pg_constraint c,
    pg_namespace nc,
    pg_class r,
    pg_namespace nr
  WHERE ((c.connamespace = nc.oid) AND (r.relnamespace = nr.oid) AND (((c.contype = 'f'::"char") AND (c.confrelid = r.oid)) OR ((c.contype = ANY (ARRAY['p'::"char", 'u'::"char"])) AND (c.conrelid = r.oid))) AND (r.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND pg_has_role(r.relowner, 'USAGE'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS object_catalog,
    objschema AS object_schema,
    objname AS object_name,
    (objtype)::character varying AS object_type,
    objdtdid AS dtd_identifier
   FROM ( SELECT attributes.udt_schema,
            attributes.udt_name,
            'USER-DEFINED TYPE'::text AS text,
            attributes.dtd_identifier
           FROM information_schema.attributes
        UNION ALL
         SELECT columns.table_schema,
            columns.table_name,
            'TABLE'::text AS text,
            columns.dtd_identifier
           FROM information_schema.columns
        UNION ALL
         SELECT domains.domain_schema,
            domains.domain_name,
            'DOMAIN'::text AS text,
            domains.dtd_identifier
           FROM information_schema.domains
        UNION ALL
         SELECT parameters.specific_schema,
            parameters.specific_name,
            'ROUTINE'::text AS text,
            parameters.dtd_identifier
           FROM information_schema.parameters
        UNION ALL
         SELECT routines.specific_schema,
            routines.specific_name,
            'ROUTINE'::text AS text,
            routines.dtd_identifier
           FROM information_schema.routines) x(objschema, objname, objtype, objdtdid);

SELECT (current_database())::name AS constraint_catalog,
    (rs.nspname)::name AS constraint_schema,
    (con.conname)::name AS constraint_name,
    (current_database())::name AS domain_catalog,
    (n.nspname)::name AS domain_schema,
    (t.typname)::name AS domain_name,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN con.condeferrable THEN 'YES'::text
            ELSE 'NO'::text
        END)::character varying(3) AS is_deferrable,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN con.condeferred THEN 'YES'::text
            ELSE 'NO'::text
        END)::character varying(3) AS initially_deferred
   FROM pg_namespace rs,
    pg_namespace n,
    pg_constraint con,
    pg_type t
  WHERE ((rs.oid = con.connamespace) AND (n.oid = t.typnamespace) AND (t.oid = con.contypid) AND (pg_has_role(t.typowner, 'USAGE'::text) OR has_type_privilege(t.oid, 'USAGE'::text)));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS udt_catalog,
    (nbt.nspname)::name AS udt_schema,
    (bt.typname)::name AS udt_name,
    (current_database())::name AS domain_catalog,
    (nt.nspname)::name AS domain_schema,
    (t.typname)::name AS domain_name
   FROM pg_type t,
    pg_namespace nt,
    pg_type bt,
    pg_namespace nbt
  WHERE ((t.typnamespace = nt.oid) AND (t.typbasetype = bt.oid) AND (bt.typnamespace = nbt.oid) AND (t.typtype = 'd'::"char") AND pg_has_role(bt.typowner, 'USAGE'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS domain_catalog,
    (nt.nspname)::name AS domain_schema,
    (t.typname)::name AS domain_name,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.typelem <> (0)::oid) AND (t.typlen = '-1'::integer)) THEN 'ARRAY'::text
            WHEN (nbt.nspname = 'pg_catalog'::name) THEN format_type(t.typbasetype, NULL::integer)
            ELSE 'USER-DEFINED'::text
        END)::character varying AS data_type,
    (information_schema._pg_char_max_length(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod))::integer AS character_maximum_length,
    (information_schema._pg_char_octet_length(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod))::integer AS character_octet_length,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_catalog,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_schema,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_name,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (nco.nspname IS NOT NULL) THEN current_database()
            ELSE NULL::name
        END)::name AS collation_catalog,
    (nco.nspname)::name AS collation_schema,
    (co.collname)::name AS collation_name,
    (information_schema._pg_numeric_precision(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod))::integer AS numeric_precision,
    (information_schema._pg_numeric_precision_radix(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod))::integer AS numeric_precision_radix,
    (information_schema._pg_numeric_scale(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod))::integer AS numeric_scale,
    (information_schema._pg_datetime_precision(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod))::integer AS datetime_precision,
    (information_schema._pg_interval_type(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod))::character varying AS interval_type,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS interval_precision,
    (t.typdefault)::character varying AS domain_default,
    (current_database())::name AS udt_catalog,
    (nbt.nspname)::name AS udt_schema,
    (bt.typname)::name AS udt_name,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_catalog,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_schema,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_name,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS maximum_cardinality,
    (1)::name AS dtd_identifier
   FROM (((pg_type t
     JOIN pg_namespace nt ON ((t.typnamespace = nt.oid)))
     JOIN (pg_type bt
     JOIN pg_namespace nbt ON ((bt.typnamespace = nbt.oid))) ON (((t.typbasetype = bt.oid) AND (t.typtype = 'd'::"char"))))
     LEFT JOIN (pg_collation co
     JOIN pg_namespace nco ON ((co.collnamespace = nco.oid))) ON (((t.typcollation = co.oid) AND ((nco.nspname <> 'pg_catalog'::name) OR (co.collname <> 'default'::name)))))
  WHERE (pg_has_role(t.typowner, 'USAGE'::text) OR has_type_privilege(t.oid, 'USAGE'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::name AS object_catalog,
    (n.nspname)::name AS object_schema,
    x.objname AS object_name,
    (x.objtype)::character varying AS object_type,
    (x.objdtdid)::name AS collection_type_identifier,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (nbt.nspname = 'pg_catalog'::name) THEN format_type(bt.oid, NULL::integer)
            ELSE 'USER-DEFINED'::text
        END)::character varying AS data_type,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS character_maximum_length,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS character_octet_length,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_catalog,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_schema,
    (NULL::name)::name AS character_set_name,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (nco.nspname IS NOT NULL) THEN current_database()
            ELSE NULL::name
        END)::name AS collation_catalog,
    (nco.nspname)::name AS collation_schema,
    (co.collname)::name AS collation_name,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS numeric_precision,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS numeric_precision_radix,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS numeric_scale,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS datetime_precision,
    (NULL::character varying)::character varying AS interval_type,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS interval_precision,
    (current_database())::name AS udt_catalog,
    (nbt.nspname)::name AS udt_schema,
    (bt.typname)::name AS udt_name,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_catalog,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_schema,
    (NULL::name)::name AS scope_name,
    (NULL::integer)::integer AS maximum_cardinality,
    (('a'::text || (x.objdtdid)::text))::name AS dtd_identifier
   FROM pg_namespace n,
    pg_type at,
    pg_namespace nbt,
    pg_type bt,
    (( SELECT c.relnamespace,
            (c.relname)::name AS relname,
                CASE
                    WHEN (c.relkind = 'c'::"char") THEN 'USER-DEFINED TYPE'::text
                    ELSE 'TABLE'::text
                END AS "case",
            a.attnum,
            a.atttypid,
            a.attcollation
           FROM pg_class c,
            pg_attribute a
          WHERE ((c.oid = a.attrelid) AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'c'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND (a.attnum > 0) AND (NOT a.attisdropped))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT t.typnamespace,
            (t.typname)::name AS typname,
            'DOMAIN'::text AS text,
            1,
            t.typbasetype,
            t.typcollation
           FROM pg_type t
          WHERE (t.typtype = 'd'::"char")
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ss.pronamespace,
            (nameconcatoid(ss.proname, ss.oid))::name AS nameconcatoid,
            'ROUTINE'::text AS text,
            (ss.x).n AS n,
            (ss.x).x AS x,
            0
           FROM ( SELECT p.pronamespace,
                    p.proname,
                    p.oid,
                    information_schema._pg_expandarray(COALESCE(p.proallargtypes, (p.proargtypes)::oid[])) AS x
                   FROM pg_proc p) ss
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.pronamespace,
            (nameconcatoid(p.proname, p.oid))::name AS nameconcatoid,
            'ROUTINE'::text AS text,
            0,
            p.prorettype,
            0
           FROM pg_proc p) x(objschema, objname, objtype, objdtdid, objtypeid, objcollation)
     LEFT JOIN (pg_collation co
     JOIN pg_namespace nco ON ((co.collnamespace = nco.oid))) ON (((x.objcollation = co.oid) AND ((nco.nspname <> 'pg_catalog'::name) OR (co.collname <> 'default'::name)))))
  WHERE ((n.oid = x.objschema) AND (at.oid = x.objtypeid) AND ((at.typelem <> (0)::oid) AND (at.typlen = '-1'::integer)) AND (at.typelem = bt.oid) AND (nbt.oid = bt.typnamespace) AND ((n.nspname, (x.objname)::name, x.objtype, ((x.objdtdid)::name)::name) IN ( SELECT data_type_privileges.object_schema,
            data_type_privileges.object_name,
            data_type_privileges.object_type,
            data_type_privileges.dtd_identifier
           FROM information_schema.data_type_privileges)));

SELECT foreign_data_wrapper_catalog,
    foreign_data_wrapper_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(fdwoptions)).option_name)::name AS option_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(fdwoptions)).option_value)::character varying AS option_value
   FROM information_schema._pg_foreign_data_wrappers w;

SELECT foreign_data_wrapper_catalog,
    foreign_data_wrapper_name,
    authorization_identifier,
    (NULL::character varying)::character varying AS library_name,
    foreign_data_wrapper_language
   FROM information_schema._pg_foreign_data_wrappers w;

SELECT foreign_server_catalog,
    foreign_server_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(srvoptions)).option_name)::name AS option_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(srvoptions)).option_value)::character varying AS option_value
   FROM information_schema._pg_foreign_servers s;

SELECT foreign_server_catalog,
    foreign_server_name,
    foreign_data_wrapper_catalog,
    foreign_data_wrapper_name,
    foreign_server_type,
    foreign_server_version,
    authorization_identifier
   FROM information_schema._pg_foreign_servers;

SELECT foreign_table_catalog,
    foreign_table_schema,
    foreign_table_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(ftoptions)).option_name)::name AS option_name,
    ((pg_options_to_table(ftoptions)).option_value)::character varying AS option_value
   FROM information_schema._pg_foreign_tables t;

SELECT foreign_table_catalog,
    foreign_table_schema,
    foreign_table_name,

SELECT l.objoid,

            WHEN (rel.relkind = 'v'::"char") THEN 'view'::text
            WHEN (rel.relkind = 'm'::"char") THEN 'materialized view'::text

            WHEN (rel.relkind = 'f'::"char") THEN 'foreign table'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS objtype,
    rel.relnamespace AS objnamespace,
        CASE
            WHEN pg_table_is_visible(rel.oid) THEN quote_ident((rel.relname)::text)
            ELSE ((quote_ident((nsp.nspname)::text) || '.'::text) || quote_ident((rel.relname)::text))
        END AS objname,
    l.provider,
    l.label
   FROM ((pg_seclabel l
     JOIN pg_class rel ON (((l.classoid = rel.tableoid) AND (l.objoid = rel.oid))))
     JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON ((rel.relnamespace = nsp.oid)))
  WHERE (l.objsubid = 0)
UNION ALL
 SELECT l.objoid,
    l.classoid,

    rel.relnamespace AS objnamespace,
    ((
        CASE
            WHEN pg_table_is_visible(rel.oid) THEN quote_ident((rel.relname)::text)

  WHERE (l.objsubid <> 0)
UNION ALL
 SELECT l.objoid,

            WHEN 'w'::"char" THEN 'window'::text

    pro.pronamespace AS objnamespace,

        CASE
            WHEN pg_function_is_visible(pro.oid) THEN quote_ident((pro.proname)::text)

        END || '('::text) || pg_get_function_arguments(pro.oid)) || ')'::text) AS objname,

UNION ALL

 SELECT l.objoid,

 SELECT l.objoid,
